value.title: No Way
value.synopsis: Mizuki Ikuta is a 25-year-old office worker in her third year at Takarazake. One day, Kurume, a senior producer, shouts at her: 'You're going to be in charge of the new programme "Super Transformation Cos ∞ Player"! and her everyday life until then changes drastically.

value.title: You're Kidding!
value.synopsis: After reading the script for the first episode of Super Transformation Cos ∞ Player, Mizuki was shocked to find that the content was completely different from the proposal. She immediately consults her boss, Umemiya, but he won't take her up on it, and then she receives a complaint from the 'real original author'.

value.title: I See!
value.synopsis: Finally, the filming of the "Super Transformation Cos ∞ Player" began. But Mizuki, feeling neglected by the staff as usual, says: 'Today is the day I'll make them recognise me as an adult woman!' and encouraged them to wear the suits she had just bought.

value.title: Men!
value.synopsis: After receiving a request from Hayakawa to have a handsome man on the show, Mizuki decides to have a beautiful young man from the armour of the enemy character, Black Prayer. In fact, she has held up the schedule of former idol and racer, Toshihide Nagasaka...

value.title: I've Had Enough!
value.synopsis: Today she would meet the man of her dreams, and her brother would bring his fiancée from New York. With these thoughts in mind, Mizuki was excited from morning. Furthermore, when she goes to visit Director Sato, she hears a very happy story...
